Extracts JSON-LD structured data from a page

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.JsonLd);
Console.WriteLine(result.JsonLd[0].SchemaType);
Console.WriteLine(result.JsonLd[0].Name);
```
